-- Add missing columns to pipelineCards (currently has: id, clientId, title, description, stage, priority, assignedTo, dueDate, completedAt, createdAt, updatedAt)
-- Queries expect: businessName, industry, budgetRange, matchScore, notes, snoozedUntil, createdBy

ALTER TABLE pipelineCards
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS businessName VARCHAR(255) NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS industry VARCHAR(255) NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS budgetRange VARCHAR(100) NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS matchScore INT DEFAULT 0,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS notes TEXT NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS snoozedUntil BIGINT DEFAULT 0,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS createdBy INT NULL;

-- Backfill businessName from existing title column for any existing rows
UPDATE pipelineCards SET businessName = title WHERE businessName IS NULL AND title IS NOT NULL;
